examples.english: And when Adam woke up out of his sleep he saw her, and he said, 'This now is bone of my bones, and flesh of [my flesh]; she shall be called 'woman,' because she was taken out of her male.'

examples.english: And when he was standing upright, having kissed his holy feet, he brought himself near his holy hands so that he might receive a blessing, and he gazed in his face, and he wished to draw his hands to him.
